note: Both sets correctly read the wiring schedule rows, but Set B covers all nine symbols more completely, capturing facts Set A omits such as circuit 20's 3#12 conductors, circuit 50's #8G ground and 1" conduit, item 34's CU material and 1" conduit, 150's 2-1/2" conduit, and 151's AL material. Set A contains two duplicated claims (item 31's 2#10 listed twice, 151's 3#4/0 listed twice) and one misread, treating the cable designation #12/2WG for item 10 as a 'conductor count: 2 WG'. Set B's claims are all supported by the schedule text, with only a cosmetic quirk of listing 'C.' as a condition on conduit-size claims. Set B is therefore more complete and more faithful.
